h1: Skin tag assessment and removal in Cairo
answer: Skin tags are soft growths often noticed where skin rubs. At {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin, adults can have a growth assessed before considering removal for irritation or appearance. A changing, bleeding or uncertain lesion needs diagnosis and may require further examination before any cosmetic procedure.
preparation: Mention changes in size or colour, bleeding and medicines that affect clotting. Avoid cutting or tying growths at home.
howPerformed: The lesion is examined first. If it is suitable for removal, the team discusses the method, pain relief and whether further testing is needed.
followup: Protect the healing site from friction and follow dressing advice. Spreading redness, drainage or persistent bleeding needs assessment.
risks: Possible effects include bleeding, infection, a small scar or a lighter or darker spot after healing.
